title: tool_running runtime event payload
description: THIN-HARNESS-REDESIGN-V2 §9.7 (2026-08-29 S5-2): a terminal command auto-backgrounded at the 300s report point — the mid-run status journaled between the call's tool_started and tool_completed. Carries 运行时长 (wall_ms), 进程状态 (pid), 输出活跃度 (total_bytes) and 落盘指针 (output_file) as structured facts; at most one per call_id (verifier-enforced).

wall_ms.description: Elapsed wall-clock since the call's tool_started when the mid-run report fired.

task_id.description: Background task id (the original tool call id for auto-background).

pid.description: Shell process pid, when the backend could surface it (进程状态).

total_bytes.description: Total output bytes observed so far, before truncation (输出活跃度).

output_file.description: Path of the output file the command keeps writing to (落盘指针).

console_mode.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): present exactly when the mid-run belongs to a direct-mode model action (audited fallback).

transition_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console → direct transition this mid-run belongs to (present together with console_mode).

trace_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console trace id of the direct action (call_id).
